name: Yondó (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and black, the green twice the height of the others and charged with three yellow oil derricks.
history: Municipal flag of Yondó, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: three oil derricks in a row
